title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Stray sheet ('Feuille parasite..' in the margin), headed 'p.d. dans les anneaux alternés'. It states a theorem; the 'Dém :' is left blank.

Setting: (S, I, γ) is a PD-ring and M* = M^0 ⊕ M^1 is a Z/2-graded S-module. Put A(M*) = Γ_S(M^0) ⊗_S Λ_S(M^1), graded by the parity of total degree. It has the obvious augmentation ε : A → S. Let J be the ideal generated by I and M* (inside A). Then J = I·A + ker ε = ε^{-1}(I).

(a) There is a PD-structure on J such that:
- S → A is a PD-morphism for (I, γ) → (J, δ);
- the structure is functorial in (S, M*).
These conditions characterise it uniquely. On the even part it is the usual extension of γ to I·Γ + Γ^+ (Berthelot). Odd elements square to zero, so they need no divided powers beyond the first.

(b) Universal property. Let B* be a Z/2-graded alternating S-algebra with a graded PD-ideal K* compatible with γ. Then restriction gives a bijection
Hom_{S-PD-alg}((A(M*), J), (B*, K*)) → Hom_{S-gr-mod}(M*, K*).
So A(M*) is the free graded-alternating S-PD-algebra on M*, i.e. the left adjoint of the forgetful functor from (graded alternating PD-algebras over (S, I, γ)) to (graded S-modules).

Purpose in the cote: for a PD-de Rham complex one needs PD-structures on graded-commutative algebras, e.g. de Rham complexes, Koszul complexes and PD-envelopes in the graded setting. This is the free object for that.
errors: Statement only, no proof, so nothing can be checked in an argument.

Implicit conventions need fixing. 'Alternée' must mean x^2 = 0 for odd x (strict anticommutativity); Grothendieck hesitated and struck out 'strict'. A graded PD-ideal must be defined so that γ_n acts on even elements, with γ_n(x) = 0 for odd x and n ≥ 2. If the latter is not assumed, uniqueness in (a) depends on that convention.
In (b), the condition on B* (that K* is compatible with γ on I) is only sketched; the image shows corrections.

ideas.what: Free divided-power algebra on a Z/2-graded module: Γ(even) ⊗ Λ(odd), with its universal property
ideas.usually_credited_to: H. Cartan, Séminaire Cartan 1954-55 ('Puissances divisées'); also Roby
ideas.where_published: Séminaire Cartan 7 (1954-55); standard in algebraic topology (Hopf algebras, Tate resolutions)

ideas.what: Extension of a PD-structure on I ⊂ S to I·A + A^+ for the free PD-algebra, compatible and functorial
ideas.where_published: Berthelot, LNM 407; Berthelot–Ogus, Notes on crystalline cohomology

deep.surprise_reason: This is a clean statement of a standard result: Cartan's graded free PD-algebra, combined with Berthelot's compatibility with a base PD-ideal. It is the expected technical lemma for a PD de Rham complex. The sheet is a stray one and contains no proof or new idea.
transcription_corrections: The marginal note at top left reads 'Feuille parasite..'.
The bracketed annotation at the top right of the theorem, '[p.d. dans les anneaux alternés]', is a heading for the theorem, not a part of the statement after J.
'A[-(M*)-]' was likely written 'A(M*)', with the M* partly overwritten.
